result.description:
A rare  full-time  opportunity has opened for a  General Practitioner  to join an established practice with a large and loyal patient base, replacing a retiring doctor. The clinic, which has been serving its community since 1973, is located in a busy shopping complex just 30 minutes north of Melbourne's CBD. The facility is well-equipped with thirteen consultation rooms, a three-bay treatment room, and a separate procedure room 

  Practice & Support  

 The incoming GP will become part of an excellent team of knowledgeable doctors and experienced support staff. The practice offers full-time dedicated nursing support for both treatment room care and chronic disease management (CDM), allowing doctors to focus on comprehensive patient care. Additionally, several on-site allied health providers extend the scope of services. The administrative team is experienced and provides support that maximizes earning potential and streamlines daily operations. This role offers full clinical autonomy as an independent contractor, along with flexible working arrangements. The clinic is also keen to support GPs who wish to pursue special interests, such as skin, aesthetics, or occupational   medicine. 

  Professional Development & Lifestyle  

 The practice places a high value on professional growth. GPs will have access to a collegial environment with supportive medical directors, and there are expanded opportunities for those interested in becoming GP Registrar Supervisors. The practice also provides support for Continuing Professional Development (CPD), including free in-house opportunities. Located in a primarily residential area, the clinic is conveniently situated with high foot traffic and ample car parking. This opportunity offers the best of both worlds: a busy, rewarding practice environment with a clear path for professional growth, all within a comfortable commute of Melbourne's vibrant city center.
